cases.description: Precondition-degradation check: the composed codebase-intelligence report declares zero files, so nothing can be scored — the engine reports zero recommendations plus an explicit 'codebase-intelligence report declared zero files' warning, rather than silently returning an empty-but-successful-looking report that hides the real reason nothing was recommended.
cases.grounding: ci_report_loader.load_ci_report returns a CiReportContext with files=[]; report.py's ci_has_warning = not ci_report.files is True, which both appends the explicit warning and short-circuits the scoring loop entirely (candidates stays []).
